name: impact rotation 664
description: What does standard rotation buy an otherwise identical team against rotation off, and how much of that result changes with the substitute's two-involvement edge? Both sides have four bench players. Flat 60 sides, fresh starts, no coach calls. The no-impact control sets uses to zero while keeping the same bench-side handoff route. The tracked rotating side plays each seed at both ends. The neutral row uses standard rotation on both sides. Compare current two 2:30 halves with two 7:00 halves (the historical §7 exposure); for 14-minute totals multiply the unrounded per-five-minute count by 14/5. Percentages stay unscaled.
